create_structured_hex8_box.description: Create a structured HEX8 finite-element box using nodes and elements. This creates FE mesh entities, not CAD geometry solids.
notes: Verified in HyperMesh 2021 through the GUI listener on port 47883.
For display, enable element display and fit/zoom extents in HyperMesh.
Do not use *solidblock or *tetmesh for this route.

create_geometry_solid_box.description: Create an axis-aligned HyperMesh geometry solid box using *solidblock. This creates CAD/geometry solid entities, not FE elements.
runtime_validation: Capture SOLIDS_BEFORE from hm_entitylist solids id, with *createmark/hm_marklength fallback for older HyperMesh Tcl.
Capture SOLIDS_AFTER and SOLID_ID; hm_latestentityid is wrapped in catch.
Treat the route as failed unless solids_count increases.
notes: This route is source-verified from local Altair HM2025 scripts and still requires GUI runtime validation in the target HyperMesh 2024/older session.
Do not reuse this route for FE mesh creation.

tetmesh_geometry_solid.reason: Tetra meshing a geometry solid was not verified in the current HyperMesh profile.
